faq.heading: Frequently asked questions
faq.bookingQuestion: How do our booking requests work?
faq.bookingItem1: Booking details and message to us: Start by sharing all the details about your event. You can also use the text field to tell us about your special wishes and requirements.
faq.bookingItem2: We find the right chef for you: We carefully review your request to ensure you get the ideal chef for your celebration who meets your requirements.
faq.bookingItem3: Contact: As soon as the right chef accepts your request, we will get in touch with you about the next steps.
faq.includedQuestion: What is included in the price?
faq.includedIntro: At peopleeat you sit back and enjoy your time as a host. This means the chef takes care of everything from grocery shopping to leaving a clean kitchen. Included in the price:
faq.includedItem1: Grocery shopping: The chef takes care of the grocery shopping.
faq.includedItem2: Meal preparation: The ingredients are freshly prepared in your kitchen.
faq.includedItem3: Serving the dishes: Enjoy being a host and don't worry about serving and plating the dishes. The chef takes care of that.
faq.includedItem4: A clean kitchen: While you and your participants enjoy the last course, the chef ensures the kitchen is left clean.
faq.includedFooter: In short, at peopleeat we offer you the opportunity to experience hosting in a new way by letting you focus entirely on your participants and the sensational dishes.
faq.advanceQuestion: How far in advance should I book a chef?
faq.advanceAnswer: Our experience: as early as possible. Chefs are in high demand and work very individually, but you can book a chef up to one week before your planned event at the latest.
faq.drinksAnswer: We currently do not offer a drink selection. We believe that enjoying your favorite beverages like wines, aperitifs, etc. fully enhances the feel-good factor and should therefore be in your hands. If you need drink suggestions, we are happy to help.
faq.cutleryQuestion: Do I need cutlery and dishes?
faq.cutleryAnswer: Usually all items are available at your place. If you need cutlery or dishes, feel free to get in touch with us. We will find a suitable solution for you.
faq.menuQuestion: How can I discuss menu details with the chef?
faq.menuAnswer: Menu adjustments can also occur after booking. You can coordinate all menu details with the chef via the chat.
faq.paymentQuestion: When do I pay for the booking?
faq.paymentAnswer: The total amount of your booking will be charged at the earliest two weeks in advance. If your event takes place within two weeks, the total amount will be charged immediately. It is important to note that your payment will only be paid out to the chef one day after the event. This ensures that everything runs smoothly and your payment is protected.

seo.title: About us
seo.description: Discover peopleeat, the team, and our mission: outstanding chefs for unforgettable moments.

about.startedHeadline: We are revolutionizing the way people host
about.startedIntro: Welcome! We are Natalia and Daniel, the founders of peopleeat!
about.startedBody: It all started when Natalia was about to move out of her apartment in Mannheim and Daniel decided to celebrate this special moment with a dinner prepared by a chef. When Daniel set out to find a chef, it quickly became clear that finding one nearby was far from easy. The search turned into a surprising challenge. After hours of looking, they finally found an available chef in Munich who was willing to make the 3.5-hour trip to Mannheim. When the chef arrived, every expectation was exceeded. Natalia and Daniel rediscovered culinary experiences, enjoyed the evening, and gained unique insights into a chef's work. That evening not only laid the foundation for peopleeat, but also a clear vision: to give people access to first-class chefs and create unforgettable moments with their loved ones.
about.missionBody: Our mission at peopleeat is to take hosting to a new level by giving people access to first-class chefs and creating unforgettable culinary experiences. We set out to celebrate the joy of food and the importance of special occasions by creating unique culinary moments that bring people closer together and create lifelong memories. At the same time, we want to give chefs the opportunity to live their passion and creativity. With our platform, we aim to unite innovation, chefs, and hospitality, and redefine the way people enjoy food and share moments.
about.teamIntro: Our team is characterized by diverse personalities and extensive experience. What unites us is a shared goal: to revolutionize the way people enjoy food and share occasions. Day after day, we work determinedly to make that vision a reality.
about.teamFounders: Daniel and Natalia, co-founders of peopleeat, bring experience in sales and financial controlling (SAP SE, Raiffeisenbank).
about.teamCto: is our CTO and Senior Full-Stack Engineer, focused on scalable web architectures and integrating AI services into existing products. Alongside his work at SAP SE, he founded, among other things,
about.teamDrawSchema: Draw Schema, a tool for visually modeling relational databases
about.teamExperts: Dirk (left) and Chris (right) are our industry experts: Dirk brings years of experience as a head chef in fine dining and as a private chef. Chris, a master chef, contributes extensive culinary expertise and has also worked for several years as a rental and private chef (Food-Fighter).
